The Ethereum Foundation stated that all upcoming upgrades will be evaluated against that timeline, underscoring the urgency of the initiative.

weekly_archive.title: Bitcoin’s complexity paradox: How layer-2 scalers became AI's main target
weekly_archive.description: A string of incidents involving Coldcard, Lightning and Liquid highlights how AI is changing the economics of finding bugs in bitcoin infrastructure.
weekly_archive.summary: AI is increasingly exploiting vulnerabilities in Bitcoin's layer-2 infrastructure including Lightning, Liquid, and Coldcard wallets, raising security concerns that could undermine confidence in scaling solutions. The growing ability of AI to efficiently find bugs in complex Bitcoin code is shifting the economics of attacks, making these networks more exposed to potential exploits.
